turns.content: I need a confident, professional LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X100VI. It’s a compact camera with a hybrid viewfinder and a 23mmF2 lens. Keep it under 80 words, please.

I created the draft and validated it against the confirmed product facts and requested constraints.

Introducing the Fujifilm X100VI – a compact camera that redefines versatility. With its innovative hybrid viewfinder, you can seamlessly switch between optical and electronic displays. The camera is equipped with a sharp 23mmF2 lens, perfect for capturing stunning images in any setting. Elevate your photography with the X100VI.
